title: Portfolio favicon directions
brief: Compare four Gentleman Kanagawa pixel marks for diegnghtmr at browser-tab size on dark and light chrome.

artboards.title: Pixel monogram
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the familiar d and gold underscore; stays readable at 16 px by confining dither to the larger versions.

artboards.title: Bayer sphere
artboards.tradeoff: Closest match to the hero's ordered shading at 32 px; the 16 px orb is less personal than an initial.

artboards.title: Terminal prompt
artboards.tradeoff: Strong 16 px separation and an immediate developer cue; less distinctive, with no dither at any size.

artboards.title: Quindío horizon
artboards.tradeoff: Most place-specific motif, taken from the footer; the terrain simplifies at 16 px to keep the sun and ridge distinct.
